record.field: Purchase Order where Matracon Pakistan opens the Import Letter of Credit

field.name: content
field.p: Through your quotation, we are pleased to confirm the order for the Supply of subjected items conforming to relevant standards for our subject project, immediately according to the following details:
M/s Matracon-KBDL-5H INSAAT is engaged in the project for which the Vendor have offered their Quotation with the rates being for the Supply and installation of subjected material.

The Vendor takes complete responsibility and obligation, as defined under this Purchase Order, technical specifications of the Contract between ADB and Matracon-KBDL-5H Insaat JV and technical submittals (including revised submittals) for Project and the Vendor irrevocably accepts the same, which now becomes part of this purchase order.

All specifications and technical submittals (including revised submittals) approved or to be approved by the Client/Consultant shall be considered as part of this Purchase Order, therefore, the Supplier shall be the responsible to fulfill all the requirements as specified therein.
Any material failing to conform to the quality testing standards shall be removed & replaced at your own cost.

The Vendor shall provide all material specifications, test reports, and test certificates, for approval by the consultant/client of the Project. Testing of materials would be the responsibility of the Vendor.

The Vendor shall submit method statements, installation procedures, and work schedules for approval prior to commencement of work. All works shall proceed only after obtaining written approval from the consultant/client of the Project.
Installation shall be carried out in accordance with approved shop drawings, method statements, and consultant recommendations.

The Vendor confirms that the quoted cost is complete and sufficient for the provision, installation, testing, commissioning, and successful operation of the equipment/system in all respects. No additional payment shall be entertained on this account.

ul.li: A warranty of 02 years will be provided, starting from the date of successful testing and commissioning.
The warranty/guarantee must be issued by the principal company, not by any authorized supplier or vendor.

Matracon-KBDL-5H INSAAT JV has submitted Performance guarantee to ADB/Employer for the performance which shall remain alive till liability period of the Project. The Vendor shall also submit an undertaking that they take complete responsibility for their supplied Subject material.

A Performance Guarantee equivalent to 25% of the total work order must be submitted, issued by a reputed Double-A insurance company, and valid for at least 2 years from the date of successful testing and commissioning.
All payments will be issued against a security cheque from a valid bank and an active account.
The supplier will be responsible for obtaining all necessary approvals from the client and appointed consultants.
The guarantee/warranty will be addressed to WASA Rawalpindi.
Transportation charges on Vendor. Unloading will be responsibility of Matracon Pakistan (Pvt) Limited.

The Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) will be conducted for subjected materials originating from USA, or Europe. The cost of travel, accommodation, and all associated expenses for five (05) persons shall be the responsibility of the supplier.

field.p: Matracon Pakistan (Pvt.) Limited will open import LC of value as per agreed amount. Moreover, Applicable taxes, duties will be paid by Matracon Pakistan (Pvt) Limited. However, such payment will be adjusted from Total cost of PO.
Balance payment will be paid item-wise as per agreed schedule in PKR cash as per the following terms:

ul.li: 10% Advance on PO
25% After 2 Months
25% after FAT
20% on BL (Bill of Lading)
10% on Delivery at site (Within 10 days of delivery)
10% on Testing, Commissioning, and Final Handing Over

record.field: Purchase Order where the Supplier arranges the Letter of Credit at their own cost

field.name: content
field.p: Through your quotation, we are pleased to confirm the order for the Supply & Installation of subjected items conforming to relevant standards for our subject project, immediately according to the following details:
M/s Matracon-KBDL-5H INSAAT is engaged in the project for which the Vendor have offered their Quotation with the rates being for the Supply and installation of subject material.

The Vendor takes complete responsibility and obligation, as defined under this Purchase Order, technical specifications of the Contract between ADB and Matracon-KBDL-5H Insaat JV and technical submittals (including revised submittals) for Project and the Vendor irrevocably accepts the same, which now becomes part of this purchase order.

All specifications and technical submittals (including revised submittals) approved or to be approved by the Client/Consultant shall be considered as part of this Purchase Order, therefore, the Supplier shall be the responsible to fulfill all the requirements as specified therein.
Any material failing to conform to the quality testing standards shall be removed & replaced at your own cost.

The Vendor shall provide all material specifications, test reports, and test certificates, for approval by the consultant/client of the Project. Testing of materials would be the responsibility of the Vendor.

The Vendor shall submit method statements, installation procedures, and work schedules for approval prior to commencement of work. All works shall proceed only after obtaining written approval from the consultant/client of the Project.
Installation shall be carried out in accordance with approved shop drawings, method statements, and consultant recommendations.

The Vendor confirms that the quoted cost is complete and sufficient for the provision, installation, testing, commissioning, and successful operation of the equipment/system in all respects. No additional payment shall be entertained on this account.

ul.li: A warranty of 02 years will be provided, starting from the date of successful testing and commissioning.
The warranty/guarantee to be issued by the Vendor.

Matracon-KBDL-5H INSAAT JV has submitted Performance guarantee to ADB/Employer for the performance which shall remain alive till liability period of the Project. The Vendor shall also submit an undertaking that they take complete responsibility for their supplied Subject material.

A Performance Guarantee equivalent to 10% of the total work order shall be submitted in the form of Bank Guarantee issued by scheduled bank of Pakistan, and shall remain valid for at least 2 years from the date of successful testing and commissioning.

The security cheque(s) submitted by the Supplier shall serve as a continuing security against the due performance of all obligations under this Purchase Order and may be presented for encashment by Matracon Pakistan (Pvt.) Limited in the event of default, non-performance, breach of contractual obligations, or failure to compensate for losses and damages arising therefrom.
The supplier will be responsible for obtaining all necessary approvals from the client and appointed consultants.
The guarantee/warranty will be addressed to WASA Rawalpindi.
Transportation, loading / unloading etc., charges will be borne by the Vendor.

The Factory Acceptance Test (FAT) will be conducted for subjected materials originating from Europe. The cost of travel, accommodation, and all associated expenses for Three (03) persons shall be the responsibility of the supplier. Alternatively, if required by the Client/Consultant, third-party inspection and testing may be carried out through SGS or any other approved third-party inspection agency nominated by the Client/Consultant.

The Vendor binds itself to complete the entire manufacturing and safe delivery at the project site within the agreed timeline from contract signing. Following successful delivery, the complete physical installation, testing, and commissioning must be executed within Two (2) Weeks.

field.p: The Supplier shall arrange and open the Letter of Credit (LC) / Bank Contract / Official Order Acknowledgment at their own cost and responsibility. The LC / Bank Contract / Official Order Acknowledgment shall explicitly reference the Project name and shall name Matracon Pakistan Private Limited as the concerned party.
All payments will be issued against a security cheque from a valid bank and an active account.
Payment will be made as follows:

ul.li: 20% Advance on PO
30% on confirmation of readiness by the factory, before FAT
10% after successful FAT
15% on BL (Bill of Lading)
5% after Delivery at site
10% after installation
10% after Testing, Commissioning, and Final Handing Over
